scoring_justification: Checker recomputes b1 at hidden distances from raw SOC CSV and checks population peak timing and magnitude from raw evolution CSV, not trusting self-reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold b1 values at selected Fe-O distances derived from paper Figure 4a and text description of ~400 cm⁻¹ peak.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Figure 4a and text: singlet-triplet coupling b1 ~400 cm⁻¹, peak shape encoded as Gaussian fit.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Analytic Gaussian function matching the paper's reported curve shape, peak magnitude, and tail.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values reflect the paper's reported SOC curve; the exact numbers are approximations consistent with the reference solution's output derived from the same curve.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold population peak time and magnitude, and spectator-state intervals from paper Figure 7 and text.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Figure 7: singlet population peak ~0.03 at t~0.5 ps, higher-spin populations nearly constant.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction of expected ranges from the paper's reported dynamics results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Ranges align with the paper's described dynamics and the reference solution's output; they are physically meaningful.

outputs.description: Spin-orbit coupling matrix elements as a function of Fe-O distance. The checker compares b1 at selected R values against hidden paper-derived reference values within an allowed tolerance, and verifies that triplet-quintet and quintet-septet couplings are negligible at larger R.

Time evolution of summed spin-multiplicity populations from wavepacket dynamics at collision energy ~0.136 eV. The checker verifies that the singlet population peak falls within a specified time window and exceeds a minimum threshold, and that quintet and septet populations remain below a small threshold throughout.

output_contract.notes: The agent must execute the full computational workflow (DFT PES generation, CASSCF SOC calculation, wavepacket dynamics) as process steps before writing the scored artifacts. No gold values or tolerances are provided publicly.
